svg.title: One flat block, plus a rule for walking it
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “One flat block, plus a rule for walking it” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing twelve values as one contiguous strip of memory with a three-by-four grid drawn above it and dotted lines connecting a few grid cells to their positions in the strip, annotated shape (3,4) strides (32,8); a transpose that changes only the strides in a quarter of a microsecond against np.ascontiguousarray copying 128 megabytes in 43.6 milliseconds; three ways of selecting every other element of a 400 megabyte array where slicing is a free view at 1.46 microseconds while fancy indexing at 70.1 milliseconds and boolean masking at 116.1 milliseconds each copy 200 megabytes; the broadcasting rule aligning shapes from the right with a mismatched case crossed out; and measured row and column traversal times differing sevenfold with memory order.
svg.text: One flat block, plus a rule for walking it
draw it from memory, then compare
